senses.en: having an extreme desire for wealth

example.en: The avaricious landlord raised the rent every year.
example.zh: 贪婪的房东每年都涨租金。

senses.en: in a way that produces no result or success

example.en: They searched fruitlessly for the missing keys all morning.
example.zh: 他们整个上午都在徒劳地寻找丢失的钥匙。

senses.en: pale yellow, especially of hair

example.en: The child had long flaxen hair.
example.zh: 这孩子有一头长长的淡黄色头发。

senses.en: able to be stretched or shaped without breaking

example.en: Copper is a ductile metal that can be drawn into wire.
example.zh: 铜是一种延展性好的金属，可以拉成丝。

senses.en: easily influenced or led

example.en: The ductile apprentice followed every instruction willingly.
example.zh: 听话的学徒乐于听从每一条指示。

senses.en: a unit of soldiers that protects the rear of an army, especially during a retreat

example.en: The rearguard held the pass to cover the army's retreat.
example.zh: 后卫部队守住关口，掩护大军撤退。

senses.en: not suitable or appropriate; awkward or unskilful

example.en: His inapt remark embarrassed everyone at the table.
example.zh: 他不恰当的话让在座的人都感到尴尬。

senses.en: parts or regions of a place

example.en: These areas get very little rain.
example.zh: 这些地区降雨很少。

senses.en: fields of study, work, or activity

example.en: We need to improve in several areas.
example.zh: 我们需要在几个方面加以改进。

senses.en: measures of the size of a surface

example.en: We measured the areas of all the rooms.
example.zh: 我们测量了所有房间的面积。

senses.en: a building or group of buildings where soldiers live

example.en: The soldiers returned to the barracks after the training exercise.
example.zh: 训练结束后士兵们回到营房。

senses.en: to write down speech or notes in written form

example.en: She transcribed the interview into a written report.
example.zh: 她把采访内容整理成书面报告。

senses.en: to rewrite music or text in a different form or notation

example.en: He transcribed the song for guitar.
example.zh: 他把这首歌改编成了吉他曲。

senses.en: relating to the front part of something

example.en: The car suffered frontal damage in the crash.
example.zh: 汽车在撞车中正面受损。

senses.en: relating to the forehead

example.en: He felt a dull frontal headache.
example.zh: 他感到前额隐隐作痛。

senses.en: a cancer of the blood-forming tissues that causes abnormal white blood cells

example.en: New treatments have improved survival rates for patients with leukemia.
example.zh: 新的治疗方法提高了白血病患者的生存率。

senses.en: nervous, tense, or easily irritated

example.en: He felt edgy before the interview.
example.zh: 面试前他感到很紧张。

senses.en: modern, bold, or daring in style

example.en: The film has a dark, edgy style.
example.zh: 这部电影风格黑暗而前卫。

senses.en: the basic facilities and systems a country or area needs to function

example.en: The city is investing in infrastructure such as roads and water systems.
example.zh: 这座城市正在投资道路和供水系统等基础设施。

senses.en: the basic structure or features of an organization or system
senses.zh: 基础架构；基础支撑体系

example.en: The study examines the infrastructure of the financial system.
example.zh: 该研究考察金融体系的基础结构。

senses.en: the state or quality of being complicated or having many connected parts

example.en: The complexity of the problem surprised the whole team.
example.zh: 这个问题的复杂性让整个团队都很惊讶。

senses.en: something that is complicated or hard to understand

example.en: The report ignores some of the complexities of the situation.
example.zh: 这份报告忽略了局势的一些复杂因素。

senses.en: a set of questions or tasks used to measure someone's knowledge or ability

example.en: She studied hard for the math test.
example.zh: 她为数学测验努力复习。

senses.en: a trial or experiment to check whether something works or is safe

example.en: The company ran a test on the new battery.
example.zh: 公司对新电池进行了测试。

senses.en: to examine or try something to see how well it works or whether it is present

example.en: Scientists tested the water for harmful bacteria.
example.zh: 科学家检测了水中的有害细菌。

senses.en: to become fully aware of something

example.en: She realized that she had left her keys at home.
example.zh: 她意识到自己把钥匙落在家里了。

senses.en: to achieve or make something happen

example.en: He worked hard to realize his dream of becoming a doctor.
example.zh: 他努力工作以实现成为医生的梦想。

senses.en: to gain money by selling something

example.en: The company realized a profit from the sale.
example.zh: 公司从这笔销售中获得了利润。

senses.en: of or relating to the sex that typically produces eggs or gives birth

example.en: The female bird has duller feathers than the male.
example.zh: 雌鸟的羽毛比雄鸟暗淡。

senses.en: a person or animal of the sex that typically produces eggs or gives birth

example.en: The female of the species usually builds the nest.
example.zh: 该物种的雌性通常筑巢。

senses.en: relating to or typical of women or girls

example.en: The company is looking for a female director.
example.zh: 该公司正在寻找一位女性董事。

senses.en: not always; not in every case

example.en: The cheapest option is not necessarily the best.
example.zh: 最便宜的选择不一定是最好的。

senses.en: as an unavoidable result; inevitably

example.en: Such delays are necessarily frustrating for passengers.
example.zh: 这类延误必然令乘客感到沮丧。

senses.en: the right to sell a company's goods or services in a particular area, or a business run under such an arrangement

example.en: He bought a fast-food franchise in the city center.
example.zh: 他在市中心买了一家快餐加盟店。

senses.en: a series of films, books, or products based on the same brand or characters
senses.zh: 系列作品，品牌系列（如电影、游戏系列）

example.en: The studio plans to turn the film into a franchise with several sequels.
example.zh: 制片方计划通过多部续集把这部电影发展成一个系列品牌。

senses.en: the right to vote in elections (formal)
senses.zh: 选举权，投票权（正式用语）

example.en: Women gained the franchise in that country in 1918.
example.zh: 该国妇女于1918年获得选举权。

senses.en: William Blake, an English poet and painter (1757–1827)

example.en: Blake wrote and illustrated his own visionary poetry.
example.zh: 布莱克创作并亲自为自己的幻想诗歌配图。

senses.en: a common English family name

example.en: Ms. Blake teaches science at our school.
example.zh: 布莱克老师在我们学校教科学。

senses.en: an official order banning trade with a country

example.en: The country lifted its oil embargo last year.
example.zh: 该国去年解除了石油禁运。

senses.en: to ban trade or the publication of something officially

example.en: The government embargoed exports of the goods.
example.zh: 政府禁止了该商品的出口。

senses.en: the mixture of gases that we breathe

example.en: Open the window to let in some fresh air.
example.zh: 打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

senses.en: the open space above the ground; the sky

example.en: The bird flew high up in the air.
example.zh: 鸟儿飞到了高高的空中。

senses.en: to broadcast a program on TV or radio

example.en: The show will air next Friday.
example.zh: 这个节目将于下周五播出。

senses.en: to put something outside to freshen or dry it

example.en: She aired the wet clothes in the sun.
example.zh: 她把湿衣服拿到太阳下晾晒。

senses.en: the amount of money needed to buy or do something

example.en: The cost of the flight went up again.
example.zh: 机票价格又涨了。

senses.en: to have a particular price

example.en: The tickets cost fifty dollars each.
example.zh: 每张票价五十美元。

senses.en: something lost, given up, or suffered to get or do something

example.en: He saved time at the cost of accuracy.
example.zh: 他以牺牲准确性为代价节省了时间。

senses.en: to cause someone to lose or suffer something

example.en: The delay cost the company an important client.
example.zh: 这次延误使公司失去了一个重要客户。

senses.en: the act of disagreeing with or resisting something

example.en: The new tax law faced strong opposition from farmers.
example.zh: 新税法遭到了农民的强烈反对。

senses.en: a political party or group that opposes the governing party

example.en: The opposition criticized the government's economic policy.
example.zh: 反对党批评了政府的经济政策。

senses.en: the relation between things that are opposed or contrasted

example.en: There is a sharp opposition between the two theories.
example.zh: 这两种理论之间存在鲜明的对立。

senses.en: a male given name, borne by famous historical figures such as Alexander the Great

example.en: Alexander was named after his grandfather.
example.zh: 亚历山大以他祖父的名字命名。

senses.en: a European coastal herb resembling celery, once used as a food plant
senses.zh: 亚历山大芹（一种欧洲海滨草本植物，形似芹菜）

example.en: Alexanders grow wild along the British coast.
example.zh: 亚历山大芹野生生长在英国海岸沿线。

senses.en: to change sugar into alcohol, or to make this happen

example.en: The grapes are left to ferment for several weeks.
example.zh: 葡萄被放置发酵数周。

senses.en: a state of excitement and unrest

example.en: The country was in a state of political ferment.
example.zh: 该国正处于政治动荡之中。

senses.en: to transfer power or responsibility to a lower level or another person

example.en: The central government devolved more powers to local authorities.
example.zh: 中央政府向地方当局下放了更多权力。

senses.en: (of duties or property) to pass automatically to someone

example.en: If she declines, the duties will devolve upon her deputy.
example.zh: 如果她拒绝，职责将转交她的副手。

senses.en: to burn something completely until it turns to ash

example.en: The factory incinerates its waste under strict regulations.
example.zh: 这家工厂在严格的规章下焚化其废料。

senses.en: used to say that someone or something has the ability or possibility to do something
senses.zh: 表示有能力或可能做某事

example.en: She can swim very well.
example.zh: 她游泳游得很好。

senses.en: a metal container for food or drink

example.en: He opened a can of soup.
example.zh: 他打开了一罐汤。

senses.en: to preserve food by putting it in a sealed can or jar

example.en: They can tomatoes every summer.
example.zh: 他们每年夏天都把番茄装罐保存。

senses.en: to take hold of something moving through the air or stop it from falling

example.en: She ran to catch the ball.
example.zh: 她跑过去接球。

senses.en: to get an illness

example.en: He caught a cold after the trip.
example.zh: 旅行后他感冒了。

senses.en: to hear or understand something

example.en: I didn't catch what she said.
example.zh: 我没听清她说什么。

senses.en: a hidden problem or difficulty

example.en: The offer sounds good, but there must be a catch.
example.zh: 这个提议听起来不错，但肯定有隐藏的问题。

senses.en: the part of the body above the neck that contains the brain, eyes, and mouth

example.en: She turned her head to look at the door.
example.zh: 她转头看向门口。

senses.en: the person in charge of a group or organization

example.en: The head of the department will decide.
example.zh: 部门负责人将作决定。

senses.en: to lead or be in charge of a group or activity

example.en: She heads a small research team.
example.zh: 她领导一个小型研究团队。

senses.en: to move or travel toward a place

example.en: We headed home after lunch.
example.zh: 午饭后我们回家了。

senses.en: a part of a plant that is often flat and green and grows from a stem or branch

example.en: A single leaf fell onto the path.
example.zh: 一片叶子落到了小路上。

senses.en: a sheet of paper, especially in a book

example.en: He turned the leaf to see the next chapter.
example.zh: 他翻过书页去看下一章。

senses.en: to turn pages quickly without reading closely

example.en: She leafed through the magazine while waiting.
example.zh: 她等待时翻阅了那本杂志。

senses.en: a married man, especially in relation to his spouse

example.en: Her husband cooks dinner every Friday.
example.zh: 她丈夫每周五做晚饭。

senses.en: to use something carefully and economically
senses.zh: 节约使用；精打细算地使用

example.en: The team husbanded its limited funds carefully.
example.zh: 团队谨慎地使用有限的资金。

senses.en: a unit of distance equal to about 1.6 kilometers

example.en: The beach is only a mile from our hotel.
example.zh: 海滩离我们酒店只有一英里。

senses.en: a long distance

example.en: From the hilltop, we could see for miles.
example.zh: 从山顶上，我们能看见很远的地方。

senses.en: the ability to learn, understand, and think clearly

example.en: She showed great intelligence in solving the puzzle.
example.zh: 她解谜时表现得非常聪明。

senses.en: secret information collected about an enemy or about a situation

example.en: The agency gathered intelligence about the planned attack.
example.zh: 该机构收集了关于这次计划袭击的情报。

senses.en: a group or organization that collects secret information

example.en: Military intelligence warned the government of the threat.
example.zh: 军事情报部门向政府发出了有关这一威胁的警告。

senses.en: an underground railway system in a city
senses.zh: 地铁；城市地下铁路系统

example.en: She takes the subway to work every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上乘地铁上班。

senses.en: a tunnel or passage for people to walk under a road

example.en: Use the subway to cross the busy road safely.
example.zh: 走地下通道可以安全地穿过这条繁忙的马路。

senses.en: a piece of thick material used to cover part of a floor

example.en: She put a soft rug beside the bed.
example.zh: 她在床边铺了一块柔软的小地毯。

senses.en: a small blanket used to keep someone warm

example.en: He wrapped a rug around his legs by the fire.
example.zh: 他在炉火旁用一条小毯子裹住双腿。

senses.en: the act of stopping and leaving a vehicle in a place

example.en: Parking here is not allowed after six.
example.zh: 六点以后这里不允许停车。

senses.en: space or an area where vehicles can be left

example.en: The hotel has plenty of parking.
example.zh: 这家酒店有很多停车位。

senses.en: the part left over after other parts have been taken away

example.en: She spent the remainder of the day reading at home.
example.zh: 她把这一天剩下的时间都用来在家读书。

senses.en: in mathematics, the amount left over after division when numbers do not divide evenly

example.en: When 17 is divided by 5, the remainder is 2.
example.zh: 17 除以 5，余数是 2。

senses.en: to sell books cheaply because they did not sell well

example.en: The publisher remaindered the unsold copies of the novel.
example.zh: 出版商把这部小说未售出的书廉价处理了。

senses.en: a bird with a heavy body and short legs, common in cities

example.en: A pigeon landed on the windowsill and looked inside.
example.zh: 一只鸽子落在窗台上，朝里看了看。

senses.en: a person who is easily cheated or tricked (informal)
senses.zh: 易受骗的人，冤大头（非正式）

example.en: Tourists are often easy pigeons for street scammers.
example.zh: 游客常常是街头骗子的好下手对象。

senses.en: a continuous humming sound, like that of a bee

example.en: I could hear the buzz of the bees in the garden.
example.zh: 我能听到花园里蜜蜂的嗡嗡声。

senses.en: excited activity or gossip about something

example.en: There was a buzz of excitement before the concert.
example.zh: 音乐会开始前气氛热烈。

senses.en: to make a low humming sound

example.en: The doorbell buzzed twice.
example.zh: 门铃响了两次。

senses.en: to become hard or firm

example.en: The clay will harden as it dries.
example.zh: 黏土干燥后会变硬。

senses.en: to make something hard or firm

example.en: The cold weather hardened the ground.
example.zh: 寒冷的天气使地面变硬了。

senses.en: to become less kind, sympathetic or willing to change one's position

example.en: Her attitude towards the negotiations hardened over time.
example.zh: 她对谈判的态度随着时间的推移变得强硬。

senses.en: very noticeable, impressive or unusual
senses.zh: 显著的；惊人的；惹人注目的

example.en: She wore a striking red dress at the party.
example.zh: 她在聚会上穿了一件引人注目的红色连衣裙。

senses.en: relating to workers stopping work in protest

example.en: Striking workers gathered outside the factory gates.
example.zh: 罢工的工人聚集在工厂大门外。

senses.en: a feeling of coldness

example.en: A chill ran through the room when the window opened.
example.zh: 窗户打开时，房间里一阵寒意。

senses.en: to make something cold or become cold

example.en: Chill the drinks in the fridge before the party.
example.zh: 聚会前把饮料放进冰箱冰镇。

senses.en: to relax and stop worrying

example.en: Just chill, everything is under control.
example.zh: 放松点，一切都在掌控中。

senses.en: relaxed and easygoing

example.en: My new neighbor seems pretty chill.
example.zh: 我的新邻居看起来很随和。

senses.en: strange or unusual; not what you would expect

example.en: The fruit has a peculiar smell that some people love.
example.zh: 这种水果有一种有些人很喜欢的奇特气味。

senses.en: belonging only to a particular person, group, or place; special

example.en: This bird is peculiar to the island and found nowhere else.
example.zh: 这种鸟是该岛特有的，其他地方找不到。

senses.en: the act or process of arranging things into groups or categories

example.en: The classification of documents by topic makes them easier to find.
example.zh: 按主题对文件进行分类使它们更容易找到。

senses.en: a group or category into which things are arranged

example.en: These two jobs fall into the same classification.
example.zh: 这两份工作属于同一类别。

senses.en: completely clean and untouched; in original perfect condition
senses.zh: 洁净的；未受破坏的；原始状态的

example.en: The beach was pristine, with white sand and clear water.
example.zh: 那片海滩原始洁净，白沙清水。

senses.en: making you feel strong emotion, especially sadness or sympathy

example.en: The film has a very touching ending.
example.zh: 这部电影的结局非常感人。

senses.en: about or concerning

example.en: He said nothing touching the matter.
example.zh: 关于这件事他什么也没说。

senses.en: the act of making physical contact with something

example.en: The touching of hands was brief and shy.
example.zh: 两人手的接触短暂而羞涩。

senses.en: very strong, sincere feeling or enthusiasm

example.en: She spoke about the project with great fervor.
example.zh: 她满怀热情地谈论这个项目。

senses.en: carrying a heavy load; heavily loaded

example.en: They returned with donkeys laden with supplies.
example.zh: 他们带着满载物资的驴回来了。

senses.en: filled or burdened with something abstract, such as emotion or meaning

example.en: Her words were laden with emotion.
example.zh: 她的话充满了感情。

senses.en: to save money or resources; avoid waste (British spelling)

example.en: The family economised by cooking at home more often.
example.zh: 这家人通过更多在家做饭来节省开支。

senses.en: marked with spots or patches of different colors

example.en: Sunlight fell through the leaves onto the dappled path.
example.zh: 阳光穿过树叶，洒在斑驳的小路上。

senses.en: putting an end to doubt or uncertainty; final and convincing

example.en: DNA evidence was conclusive in identifying the suspect.
example.zh: DNA证据在确认嫌疑人方面具有决定性。

senses.en: a condition caused by losing too much water from the body

example.en: Drink water regularly to avoid dehydration in hot weather.
example.zh: 在炎热的天气里要经常喝水以避免脱水。

senses.en: the removal of water from something, such as food

example.en: Dehydration is a common method of preserving fruit.
example.zh: 脱水是保存水果的常用方法。

senses.en: firmly loyal and not changing or wavering

example.en: She remained steadfast in her support for her friend.
example.zh: 她始终坚定地支持她的朋友。

senses.en: to hate or find something morally disgusting

example.en: Most people abhor cruelty to animals.
example.zh: 大多数人憎恶虐待动物的行为。

senses.en: to move or travel from one place to another

example.en: Snails locomote very slowly.
example.zh: 蜗牛移动得非常缓慢。

senses.en: people receiving medical care

example.en: The doctor sees twenty patients a day.
example.zh: 这位医生每天看二十位病人。
